tests.question: Choose the correct articles for the gaps: 'Look at ___ moon in ___ sky. It's so bright and beautiful!'
options: the / the
the / a
a / a
a / the
tests.explanation: Qrammatika qaydalarına əsasən (Grammar Target), təbiətdə tək olan isimlərin (moon, sky, sun) qarşısında həmişə müəyyənlik artiklı olan 'the' istifadə olunur.

tests.question: Choose the correct option to complete the sentence: 'I saw ___ colourful butterfly in ___ garden.'
options: a / an
the / a
a / the
an / the
tests.explanation: Ümumi, qeyri-müəyyən bir kəpənəkdən bəhs edildiyi üçün ilk boşluqda 'a', müəyyən bir bağ (konkret yer) nəzərdə tutulduğu üçün isə ikinci boşluqda 'the' istifadə olunmalıdır. Tələffüz samitlə başladığı üçün 'an' yox, 'a' olur.

tests.question: What happened to Reuben after he woke up from a coma according to the text?
options: He started speaking in a German accent.
He became a fluent English teacher.
He couldn't recognise his family members.
He woke up and started speaking in Spanish.
tests.explanation: Mətndə 'A Football Player's Spanish Surprise' hekayəsində Reubenin komadan oyandıqdan sonra sürpriz şəkildə 'I'm hungry' cümləsini İspan dilində deməsi və bu dildə danışmağa başlaması qeyd olunur.

tests.question: Read the sentence and complete it with the correct phrase: 'Joining the school choir gave me ___; we feel like one big family.'
options: a secret code
an early connection
a sense of belonging
a special treasure
tests.explanation: Dərslikdəki lüğət tapşırığına əsasən, özünü bir qrupun və ya yerin parçası kimi hiss etmək 'a sense of belonging' (mənsubiyyət hissi) adlanır. Xor qrupunda ailə kimi hiss etmək məhz bu ifadəni tələb edir.

tests.question: According to the listening text, which statement is TRUE about the Pirahã people?
options: They avoid forming good relationships with their children.
They worry about their future and plan ahead carefully.
They have a very complex system of words for large numbers.
They live in the present moment and do not discuss the past.
tests.explanation: Mətndəki 'Listening' tapşırığına əsasən, Pirahã xalqı keçmiş və gələcək haqqında deyil, yalnız indiki zaman haqqında danışır ('They can talk about the present'). Onların mücərrəd ideyalara və rəqəmlərə xüsusi sözləri yoxdur.

tests.question: Which sentence has a grammatically INCORRECT use of articles?
options: When the moon is full, the night sky becomes bright and magical.
He has a beautiful painting of a flower on his wall.
In our class, Tim is an only person who can solve complex math problems quickly.
The teacher told us a fascinating story about ancient civilisations.
tests.explanation: Dərslikdəki 'Mistake Detector' və qrammatika qaydalarına əsasən, 'only' sözü 'yeganə' mənasında çıxış etdikdə özündən əvvəl 'the' artiklı tələb edir ('the only person'). 'An only person' qrammatik olaraq səhvdir.

tests.question: Choose the correct form of the word to complete the sentence: 'Playing games with friends is always ___.'
options: enjoy
enjoyable
enjoyably
enjoyment
tests.explanation: Cümlədə 'to be' (is) felindən sonra sifət gəlməlidir. 'Enjoy' feldir, 'enjoyment' isimdir, 'enjoyably' zərfdir. Düzgün sifət forması 'enjoyable' (əyləncəli, zövqlü) olmalıdır.

tests.question: According to the survey published by the European Commission, why are the British considered the worst language learners in Europe?
options: Because they start learning foreign languages in preschools but forget them.
Because learning a foreign language is extremely popular at UK schools.
Because they give up learning languages very late at the age of 18.
Because most of them cannot speak any language apart from English.
tests.explanation: Mətndə göstərilir ki, britaniyalıların 62 faizi ingilis dilindən başqa heç bir dil bilmir. Onlar dilləri öyrənməyə 11 yaşında başlayıb 14 yaşında buraxırlar.

tests.question: In the article, what does the author mean by the metaphor 'water lily children'?
options: Children who prefer to study botany and grow beautiful flowers.
Children who know many languages but lack a strong foundation in their mother tongue.
Children who are fluent in many languages and have a deep cultural background.
Children who only speak their mother tongue and refuse to learn English.
tests.explanation: Mətndə 'water lily children' belə izah olunur: 'These are kids who know many languages but aren't really good at any. It's like having a flower floating on the water without strong roots.' Bu o deməkdir ki, onların öz ana dillərində güclü təməlləri yoxdur.

tests.question: How many articles are MISSING in the following sentence: 'sun is shining brightly and giving us light and warmth.'?
options: Two definite articles
One indefinite article
One definite and one indefinite article
One definite article
tests.explanation: Cümlədə yalnız 'sun' (günəş) isminin qarşısında 'The' artiklı buraxılıb ('The sun is shining...'). 'Light' və 'warmth' mücərrəd isimlər olduğu və ümumi mənada işləndiyi üçün artikl tələb etmir.

tests.question: Identify the sentence that contains a mistake according to the English grammar rules provided in the unit.
options: We were excited to try a new restaurant, but a restaurant we chose was terrible.
Speaking a language fluently means you can tell your friends about your day.
Just like how food is essential for my body, learning new things is important.
The Internet has changed the way people look for homes.
tests.explanation: 'Mistake Detector' bölməsinə və qrammatika qaydalarına əsasən, əgər biz artıq haqqında danışdığımız müəyyən bir restorandan bəhs ediriksə, 'a restaurant' deyil, 'the restaurant we chose' olmalıdır. Digər cümlələr qrammatik cəhətdən doğru versiyalardır.

tests.question: According to the video by Lydia Machova, what happens if you ONLY memorise a list of words for a test?
options: It results in storing the words only in your short-term memory.
It allows you to speak the language effortlessly from day one.
It helps you become a fluent polyglot in a short amount of time.
It creates a strong and permanent connection with the culture.
tests.explanation: Mətndə (Watch the second part of the video) verilən tapşırıqda 'Memorising a list of words for a test may result in storing them in short-term memory' ifadəsi xüsusi vurğulanır. Əzbərləmək sözlərin yalnız qısa müddətli yaddaşda qalmasına səbəb olur.

tests.question: According to the grammar rules in the unit, which of the statements about articles is FALSE?
options: We do not use articles 'a', 'an', and 'the' before pronouns.
We use the definite article 'the' when there is only one of something.
We use the indefinite articles 'a' and 'an' before plural nouns.
We use 'the' with a specific noun to refer to specific things and people.
tests.explanation: Qrammatika qaydalarına əsasən, qeyri-müəyyənlik artiklları ('a', 'an') yalnız sayılan tək isimlərin (singular only) qarşısında istifadə olunur. Cəm isimlərin qarşısında 'a/an' istifadə edilməsi qrammatik olaraq yanlışdır.

tests.question: According to the text about "The Harry Potter" series, what do Harry and his friends work together to do?
options: They work together to find new friends from different countries.
They work together to solve mysteries and improve their magical skills.
They work together to build a new school for wizards called Hogwarts.
They work together to write fiction books about magical creatures.
tests.explanation: Mətndə qeyd olunur ki, "Harry and his friends work together to solve mysteries and improve their magical skills." Digər variantlar mətndə öz əksini tapmayıb.

tests.question: Choose the correct definition for the word "fiction" as it is used in the unit.
options: A short story that always teaches a moral lesson.
A type of material that people use for making clothes.
A type of literature that describes imaginary people and events.
A book that is based on real historical facts and biographies.
tests.explanation: Dərslikdə "fiction" sözünün mənası "a type of literature that describes imaginary people and events, not real ones" kimi verilmişdir.

tests.question: Which of the following words is an abstract noun?
options: Library
Courage
Tree
Bookworm
tests.explanation: "Courage" (cəsarət) mücərrəd isimdir (abstract noun), çünki ona fiziki olaraq toxunmaq və ya onu görmək mümkün deyil. Digərləri konkret (concrete) isimlərdir.

tests.question: What does a true "bookworm" usually do according to the text?
options: A true bookworm prefers only reading science and historical magazines.
A true bookworm only reads books when they have a lot of free time.
A true bookworm is someone who cannot take their nose out of a book.
A true bookworm always watches the movie adaptations of books first.
tests.explanation: Mətndə aydın şəkildə yazılıb: "a true bookworm is someone who actually can't take their nose out of a book". Kitabqurdları filmlərə getməkdənsə həmişə kitab oxumağı üstün tuturlar.

tests.question: Which word from the text means "the ability to read and write"?
options: Literacy
Empathy
Imagination
Concentration
tests.explanation: Dərslikdə "literacy" sözü oxuma və yazma bacarığı (savadlılıq) kimi qeyd olunur. Mətndə "Reading is a key component of early literacy development" cümləsində bu ifadə keçir.

tests.question: Complete the sentence with the correct form: "To become a good reader requires ________ and patience."
options: practices
the practices
practice
a practice
tests.explanation: "Practice" sözü burada mücərrəd və sayılmayan isim kimi işlənir, ona görə də qarşısında "a/an" artiklı və ya cəm şəkilçisi (-s) qəbul etmir. Doğru forma "practice"-dir.

tests.question: Why does the author mention that "most of the popular TV shows and movies are based on books"?
options: To complain that modern movies do not use original stories anymore.
To show that reading allows you to picture everything in your head like a cinema.
To suggest that reading non-fiction books takes too much attention span.
To prove that watching TV shows is better than reading fiction books.
tests.explanation: Mətndə "Did you know that most of the popular TV shows and movies are based on books? ... When you read, you can picture everything in your head... It's like having your very own cinema inside your brain!" yazılıb. Yəni məqsəd oxuyarkən hər şeyi təsəvvür edə biləcəyimizi göstərməkdir.

tests.question: Complete the sentence with the correct idiom: "To understand others, you should try to ________ even if they are different from you."
options: set an example for them
take your nose out of a book
dive into the world of reading
put yourself in their shoes
tests.explanation: İdiomun mənası özünü başqasının yerinə qoymaqdır. Mətndə empatiya qurmaq üçün "putting us in the shoes of the characters" ifadəsi istifadə olunur.

tests.question: Choose the correct option to make a generalisation: "________ take us on amazing adventures with unreal stories."
options: Fiction book
The fiction book
Fiction books
A fiction books
tests.explanation: Sayılan isimlərlə ümumiləşdirmə (generalisation) edərkən artiklsız cəm isim (no article + plural noun) istifadə olunur: "Fiction books".

tests.question: In the story about Tim, how did he successfully climb down the tall tree?
options: He used the "Hug-and-Slide" method that he remembered from his favourite storybook.
He waited in the tree until he stopped being scared and jumped down.
He called for help and a police officer came to rescue him.
His friends came closer and helped him to get down safely from the branches.
tests.explanation: Mətndə qeyd olunur ki, Tim kitabda oxuduğu qəhrəmanın üsulunu xatırlayır: "Tim decided to hug the trunk of the tree and slowly slide down... using the Hug-and-Slide method."

tests.question: Which word best completes the sentence: "Children are keen on repeating adults. So, parents can ________ by reading regularly."
options: set a positive example
judge books based on genre
overcome their difficulties
shorten their attention span
tests.explanation: Dərslikdə "you can set a positive example by reading regularly. Children are keen on repeating the adults" cümləsi verilmişdir. "Set an example" (nümunə olmaq) doğru cavabdır.

tests.question: Choose the correct sentence regarding abstract and concrete nouns.
options: My grandma gives me a good advice when I feel confused.
My grandma gives me the good advices when I feel confused.
My grandma gives me good advice when I feel confused.
My grandma gives me good advices when I feel confused.
tests.explanation: "Advice" mücərrəd və sayılmayan isimdir. Sayılmayan isimlər "a/an" artiklı ilə işlənmir və cəmlənmir (advices olmur). Bu səbəbdən "good advice" forması düzgündür.

tests.question: According to the text, how does reading books about people who have overcome difficulties affect the reader?
options: It helps them improve their writing skills and vocabulary.
It can inspire them to do the same and teach them to never give up.
It makes them feel sad about their own real-life problems.
It shortens their attention span and requires more concentration.
tests.explanation: Mətndə yazılır: "Reading books about people who have overcome difficulties can inspire us to do the same. The right book can teach you to never give up."

tests.question: Which of the following rules for making a generalisation about an uncountable subject is correct according to the textbook?
options: We always make the uncountable subject plural to show generalisation.
We don't use an article to make a generalisation about an uncountable subject.
We must use the definite article "the" before the uncountable subject.
We should use the indefinite article "a/an" with the uncountable subject.
tests.explanation: Dərslikdəki qrammatika qaydasına əsasən: "We don't use an article to make a generalisation about an uncountable subject of the sentence."

tests.question: According to the text, why does reading improve empathy?
options: Because when we read, we have to remember characters, which is a memory workout.
Because reading non-fiction provides us with essential information about science.
Because books teach us to understand others by seeing different thoughts and situations.
Because reading helps us discover the history of our roots and increases knowledge.
tests.explanation: Mətndə "Books help us experience realities outside of our lives... When we read, we get better at empathy because we see lots of different thoughts and situations that are not always like ours" ifadəsi yer alır.

tests.question: What does the phrase "attention span" mean in the context of reading books in a world with fast gadgets?
options: The process of putting yourself in another person's shoes to show empathy.
The act of taking your nose out of a book to look at modern gadgets.
The ability to read a book very quickly without understanding the story.
The length of time for which somebody is able to concentrate on something.
tests.explanation: Lüğətdə "attention span" ifadəsinin tərifi "the length of time for which somebody is able to concentrate on something" olaraq verilib (diqqət müddəti).

tests.question: Identify the correct sentence that makes a generalisation about a countable subject.
options: The good reader love to play and learn new things every day.
Good reader loves to play and learn new things every day.
A good reader loves to play and learn new things every day.
A good readers love to play and learn new things every day.
tests.explanation: Sayılan isimlərlə ümumiləşdirmə iki yolla edilir: ya "a/an + singular noun" (A good reader loves...), ya da "no article + plural noun" (Good readers love...). Buna görə A variantı qrammatik cəhətdən tamamilə doğrudur.

tests.question: Which group of words consists ONLY of abstract nouns?
options: Challenge, friend, knowledge, character
Beauty, kindness, hero, library
Honesty, courage, truth, advice
Enjoyment, puzzle, happiness, story
tests.explanation: A variantındakı bütün sözlər (honesty, courage, truth, advice) mücərrəd isimlərdir. B variantında "hero" və "library", C-də "friend", D-də isə "puzzle" və "story" konkret isimlərdir.

tests.question: Read the sentence and choose the exact synonym for the word "overcome" as it is used in the phrase "people who have overcome difficulties".
options: start doing something with enthusiasm
focus all attention and energy on one thing
make something worse than before
succeed in controlling a problem
tests.explanation: Mətndəki lüğət hissəsinə əsasən, "overcome" sözü "succeed in controlling a problem" mənasına uyğun gəlir.

tests.question: In a third-person narrative, what is the main purpose of the introduction paragraph according to the Writing Tips?
options: To provide a detailed description of the events exactly in order.
To set the scene by explaining who was involved, time, and place.
To say what happened in the end and refer to people's feelings.
To use a clear subject line that shows the purpose of the email.
tests.explanation: Writing tips bölməsində "Third-person Narratives" üçün giriş hissəsi (introduction) belə təsvir olunur: "set the scene (who was involved, time, place, etc.) in an interesting way to help the reader imagine the scene".

tests.question: Choose the correct articles for the gaps: 'Look at ___ moon in ___ sky. It's so bright and beautiful!'
options: a / a
the / a
a / the
the / the
tests.explanation: Qrammatika qaydalarına əsasən (Grammar Target), təbiətdə tək olan isimlərin (moon, sky, sun) qarşısında həmişə müəyyənlik artiklı olan 'the' istifadə olunur.

the / a
a / an
an / the

enjoyable
enjoy

tests.question: Complete the sentence with the correct form: "To become a good reader requires ________ and patience."
options: practice
practices
a practice
the practices
tests.explanation: "Practice" sözü burada mücərrəd və sayılmayan isim kimi işlənir, ona görə də qarşısında "a/an" artiklı və ya cəm şəkilçisi (-s) qəbul etmir. Doğru forma "practice"-dir.

tests.question: Why does the author mention that "most of the popular TV shows and movies are based on books"?
options: To complain that modern movies do not use original stories anymore.
To suggest that reading non-fiction books takes too much attention span.
To show that reading allows you to picture everything in your head like a cinema.
To prove that watching TV shows is better than reading fiction books.
tests.explanation: Mətndə "Did you know that most of the popular TV shows and movies are based on books? ... When you read, you can picture everything in your head... It's like having your very own cinema inside your brain!" yazılıb. Yəni məqsəd oxuyarkən hər şeyi təsəvvür edə biləcəyimizi göstərməkdir.

tests.question: Complete the sentence with the correct idiom: "To understand others, you should try to ________ even if they are different from you."
options: put yourself in their shoes
take your nose out of a book
dive into the world of reading
set an example for them
tests.explanation: İdiomun mənası özünü başqasının yerinə qoymaqdır. Mətndə empatiya qurmaq üçün "putting us in the shoes of the characters" ifadəsi istifadə olunur.

tests.question: Choose the correct option to make a generalisation: "________ take us on amazing adventures with unreal stories."
options: The fiction book
A fiction books
Fiction books
Fiction book
tests.explanation: Sayılan isimlərlə ümumiləşdirmə (generalisation) edərkən artiklsız cəm isim (no article + plural noun) istifadə olunur: "Fiction books".

tests.question: In the story about Tim, how did he successfully climb down the tall tree?
options: He called for help and a police officer came to rescue him.
He used the "Hug-and-Slide" method that he remembered from his favourite storybook.
He waited in the tree until he stopped being scared and jumped down.
His friends came closer and helped him to get down safely from the branches.
tests.explanation: Mətndə qeyd olunur ki, Tim kitabda oxuduğu qəhrəmanın üsulunu xatırlayır: "Tim decided to hug the trunk of the tree and slowly slide down... using the Hug-and-Slide method."

tests.question: Which word best completes the sentence: "Children are keen on repeating adults. So, parents can ________ by reading regularly."
options: set a positive example
shorten their attention span
judge books based on genre
overcome their difficulties
tests.explanation: Dərslikdə "you can set a positive example by reading regularly. Children are keen on repeating the adults" cümləsi verilmişdir. "Set an example" (nümunə olmaq) doğru cavabdır.

tests.question: According to the text, how does reading books about people who have overcome difficulties affect the reader?
options: It helps them improve their writing skills and vocabulary.
It makes them feel sad about their own real-life problems.
It can inspire them to do the same and teach them to never give up.
It shortens their attention span and requires more concentration.
tests.explanation: Mətndə yazılır: "Reading books about people who have overcome difficulties can inspire us to do the same. The right book can teach you to never give up."

tests.question: Which of the following rules for making a generalisation about an uncountable subject is correct according to the textbook?
options: We don't use an article to make a generalisation about an uncountable subject.
We should use the indefinite article "a/an" with the uncountable subject.
We must use the definite article "the" before the uncountable subject.
We always make the uncountable subject plural to show generalisation.
tests.explanation: Dərslikdəki qrammatika qaydasına əsasən: "We don't use an article to make a generalisation about an uncountable subject of the sentence."

tests.question: According to the text, why does reading improve empathy?
options: Because books teach us to understand others by seeing different thoughts and situations.
Because when we read, we have to remember characters, which is a memory workout.
Because reading helps us discover the history of our roots and increases knowledge.
Because reading non-fiction provides us with essential information about science.
tests.explanation: Mətndə "Books help us experience realities outside of our lives... When we read, we get better at empathy because we see lots of different thoughts and situations that are not always like ours" ifadəsi yer alır.

tests.question: Identify the correct sentence that makes a generalisation about a countable subject.
options: The good reader love to play and learn new things every day.
A good reader loves to play and learn new things every day.
A good readers love to play and learn new things every day.
Good reader loves to play and learn new things every day.
tests.explanation: Sayılan isimlərlə ümumiləşdirmə iki yolla edilir: ya "a/an + singular noun" (A good reader loves...), ya da "no article + plural noun" (Good readers love...). Buna görə A variantı qrammatik cəhətdən tamamilə doğrudur.

tests.question: Which group of words consists ONLY of abstract nouns?
options: Beauty, kindness, hero, library
Challenge, friend, knowledge, character
Honesty, courage, truth, advice
Enjoyment, puzzle, happiness, story
tests.explanation: A variantındakı bütün sözlər (honesty, courage, truth, advice) mücərrəd isimlərdir. B variantında "hero" və "library", C-də "friend", D-də isə "puzzle" və "story" konkret isimlərdir.

tests.question: Read the sentence and choose the exact synonym for the word "overcome" as it is used in the phrase "people who have overcome difficulties".
options: succeed in controlling a problem
make something worse than before
focus all attention and energy on one thing
start doing something with enthusiasm
tests.explanation: Mətndəki lüğət hissəsinə əsasən, "overcome" sözü "succeed in controlling a problem" mənasına uyğun gəlir.

tests.question: In a third-person narrative, what is the main purpose of the introduction paragraph according to the Writing Tips?
options: To use a clear subject line that shows the purpose of the email.
To set the scene by explaining who was involved, time, and place.
To provide a detailed description of the events exactly in order.
To say what happened in the end and refer to people's feelings.
tests.explanation: Writing tips bölməsində "Third-person Narratives" üçün giriş hissəsi (introduction) belə təsvir olunur: "set the scene (who was involved, time, place, etc.) in an interesting way to help the reader imagine the scene".

tests.question: In the provided grammar task, what is the tag question for 'Don't be late for the meeting'?
options: are you?
do you?
will you?
can you?
tests.explanation: The example gives: 'Don't be late for the meeting, will you?'.

tests.question: What should Student A mime to their partner in Grammar B activity?
options: A sentence
The first adjective
A tag question
A strong noun
tests.explanation: The text instructs Student A: 'Mime the first adjective to your partner.'

tests.question: Which of the following is given as the strong version of the adjective 'angry'?
options: exhausted
furious
delighted
terrified
tests.explanation: The table explicitly shows 'angry-furious'.
